description: Every MoSPI CPI item (2024 base, all-India combined, 358 items), monthly from Jan 2026: item weight (%), MoSPI published y/y, and its contribution (pp) to combined CPI y/y: weight x 12-month change in the item index / headline index a year earlier (Asia Decoded calculation; they add up to CPI y/y). Built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/cpi_core/in_cpi_items.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India CPI item contributions
